ryan (product): Draft manifest sample (WIP) pasted to drive -> https://drive.redwood.internal/marketplace/manifest-draft.json

ana (partner-ops): Owners confirmed: copy/manifest -> ryan; legal -> lee; cloud templates -> samir. Sync tomorrow 09:30 to do a dry-run. :thumbsup:
